Last month, SpaceXAI launched Grok Bot, an AI system similar to iMessage that displays agents as teammates. The product was initially launched as iPhone and Mac apps, with very expensive pricing. However, in the weeks following its launch, Grok Bot has expanded to iPad and significantly reduced its price.

Grok Bot Lands on iPad and Android

Like many AI services, Grok Bot was initially launched on Mac, with an added iPhone app. This week, SpaceXAI expanded Grok Bot to two other platforms: Android and iPad.

The launch of the tablet version coincides perfectly with Grok Bot's new enterprise support. For enterprise customers of Grok and Cursor, Grok Bot will be free for the next few weeks.

Meanwhile, over the past few weeks, aside from the free trial period, the price to try Grok Bot has dropped significantly.

This AI agent system originally required a subscription of US$300 per month. Now Grok Bot can be used with Cursor Pro, which is a US$20-per-month plan, priced comparably to other entry-level AI subscription services.

SpaceXAI recently acquired Cursor, a deal that helps them become more competitive in the AI field and reverse their previously lagging position.
